questions: Does 'even intervals' mean that the differences j-i and k-j must be equal, or does it mean that the indices i, j, k themselves must be even numbers?
Are the intervals required to be strictly positive and equal (j-i = k-j > 0), or can they be zero (i.e., consecutive characters)?
Is the order of characters strictly A then B then C, or could they be any permutation as long as they appear in that order at even intervals?
Should the answer count all triples (i,j,k) satisfying the conditions, or only those where the interval length is the same for both steps?
Are overlapping triples allowed (e.g., same i used in multiple triples)?
Is the input guaranteed to contain only uppercase English letters, and should we treat characters case-sensitively?
What should be output if no such triple exists? (Presumably 0, but is that specified?)
Are the indices 1-based as written (1 ≤ i < j < k ≤ |S|), or should they be interpreted as 0-based in implementation?
